result.notes: Controls caught a real instrument bug before it shipped: all XX-append mutants of one file share byte size, and CPython pyc invalidation keys on (mtime-seconds, size), so sub-second consecutive suite runs silently executed the PREVIOUS mutant's stale pyc — first HEAD run falsely reported the '--filter' option and 'list' group renames as survivors. Fixed with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 on every pytest subprocess; documented in the spec doc since any extension of this detector would rediscover it the hard way. Method: copy tree to temp workdir (cwd shadows the editable install — verified empirically), green-baseline check (exit 2 on red), coverage pass with per-test contexts restricts mutation to executed lines (unexecuted lines belong to the coverage gate) and supplies the nearest-covering-spec attribution, deterministic AST-level sampling (invert-conditional, delete-branch-body, swap-comparison, swap-constant; docstrings and annotations skipped), caps: 4/function, 60 total, per-mutant timeout 5x baseline. Runtime ~max_mutants x baseline suite time; 26s on this repo. Pushed on branch claude/bookminder-recall-5ite2s.
